name: Baile Charme Dance
blurb: One photo in: you do the smooth Rio charme steps in a packed night street party, crowd clapping around you.

prompts.label: Template prompt
prompts.text: Use the photo as the main character and keep the person exactly as photographed: same face, hair, skin tone, body shape and outfit. A packed street party at night in an old Rio de Janeiro square, colonial building fronts, bright white street lamps overhead, blue party tents and a crowd of dancers all around, filmed on a phone held at chest height inside the crowd, vertical 9:16, framed from the knees up. (1) They stand among the crowd, nodding to the beat with a cool, unbothered face. (2) The charme step: smooth side-to-side two-steps, shoulders rolling, knees soft, both hands rolling and clapping low in front of the hips. (3) A slow turn on the spot, a point at the camera, then back into the side steps while the people around them cheer and clap. Real party footage, warm and joyful, natural motion, one continuous shot. Audio: crowd noise and a smooth original slow R&B groove, no vocals. Exactly one person in focus dancing, no text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
